description:
No spec subject (candidates: specled.severity when picked up). Severity: Low. From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. A Spec-Drift commit trailer that escalates/relaxes a finding changes the resolved severity but the report never says a trailer did it — the override is invisible in output. Keep-reason: report-format addition, out of scope for the shipped defect-fix branch. Concrete failure: a reviewer reading spec.check output cannot distinguish a config default from a per-commit trailer override, so an escaped relaxation trailer passes unnoticed.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.severity, specled.spec_drift_trailer

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check/severity.ex
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex
- .spec/specs/severity.spec.md
- .spec/specs/spec_drift_trailer.spec.md
- .spec/realization_hashes.json  (REQUIRED: SpecLedEx.BranchCheck.Severity is a bare-module
  api_boundary entry at .spec/realization_hashes.json:103; a bare-module hash is the union of
  public heads, so adding ANY public function drifts it. resolve/3 and sanitized/3 are also
  tracked at :108 and :113.)
- test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/branch_check/trailer_test.exs
- CHANGELOG.md

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex
- docs/**

Out of Scope (intent):
- Render provenance in the REPORT MAP / HTML only, NOT on the stdout summary line. That line is
  pinned verbatim by specled.tasks.branch_findings_breakdown (.spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:292-301).
  Staying off it keeps specled.mix_tasks out of Advances and avoids colliding with specled_-bg5.5.
- Do NOT change the precedence chain or the :off-absorbing rule (specled.severity.off_is_absorbing).
  This ticket is observability only.
- Do NOT change resolve/3's return to a tuple. Four call sites (branch_check.ex:288,
  branch_check.ex:457, lib/specled_ex/config/prose.ex:121, and emit/6) assume a bare atom.
  Add resolve_with_source/3 and keep resolve/3 delegating.
- Do NOT add trailer verification. specled.spec_drift_trailer.self_report_documented deliberately
  states trailers are unverified cooperative self-report.

TRAP — read before designing: --accept-drift injects a SYNTHETIC trailer override
(lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex:298-307, %{"branch_guard_realization_drift" => :info} at
:trailer_override precedence). A naive "a Spec-Drift trailer set this" label would falsely
attribute --accept-drift runs to a trailer present in no commit. Your provenance value MUST
distinguish the flag-injected override from a real commit trailer.

Verification:
  mix test test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_test.exs \
           test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs \
           test/specled_ex/branch_check/trailer_test.exs \
           test/specled_ex/branch_check_test.exs
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix format --check-formatted
  make xref
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
Note: severity_integration_test.exs:101-120 asserts, by reading lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex
as a string, that every emission routes through Severity.resolve( and that no "error"/"warning"
literal sits on a branch_guard finding. A rename trips it. That is the contract, not breakage.

Expected diff: ~90-140 lines across 6-8 files.
title: F11: Spec-Drift trailer override leaves no trace in report output
